name: Labyrinth of Misery (CR 15)
body:
Labyrinth of Misery
CR 15

XP 51,200
Type magical; Perception DC 33; Disable Device DC 31

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (alarm); Reset 1 round
Effect spell effect (triggering creature is affected by a maze spell); a creature caught in the maze takes 6d6 points of damage and takes 1d4 points of Charisma damage each round for the first 3 rounds it is trapped in the maze (Will DC 22 negates the Charisma damage)
